title: serving-runtime daily scratchpad - 2026-03-18
content:
Morning log (18 Mar 2026)---
Context: quick personal scratchpad for serving-runtime work. Mostly triage notes and perf TODOs.

Daily goals:
- unblock customer A on K80 fallback issue (JIRA-RT-412)
- repro intermittent perf regression seen on 2048-token workloads
- prototype small change to KV-cache eviction heuristic (fastpath)
- triage kernel segfaults from canary on p4d

Notes / running list:
1) K80 fallback problem (customer A)
   - Symptoms: requests falling back to CPU for certain model variants after ~3 hours of steady load. Latency spikes ~800ms.
   - Initial hypothesis: routing policy incorrectly marks GPU nodes as unhealthy due to transient oom events and never re-enables them.
   - Repro steps: run load test with batch size=8, seq_len=1024, model=llama-13b-8bit-qat, inject memory-pressure script on node.
   - Next actions: add extra logging in healthchecker (healthcheck/manager.go) around markUnhealthy reason; instrument time-since-last-success. @Marco to check node-exporter logs for oom_kill.
   - Linked: JIRA-RT-412, PR #678 for small healthcheck logging patch.

2) Perf regression on 2048-token path
   - Observed: 5-8% slower p99 on 2048 vs yesterday on same infra (p4d). Not seen on 512/1024.
   - Suspect: attention kernel path chooses non-optimal kernel when sequence length crosses threshold. Kernel selector map shows threshold at 1536.
   - Quick experiment: force kernel A for 2048 in local binary and run microbench. If p99 improves, adjust selector threshold and add test.
   - TODO: create perf harness script under /bench/seqlen/2048 and run overnight with varying batch sizes. @Priya to run overnight.

3) KV-cache eviction heuristic (fastpath)
   - Problem: small-context prompts repeatedly recompute when cache misses due to shard-level skew. Eviction currently LRU per-shard; want soft-LRU with global bias to keep recent prefixes for hot routes.
   - Brainstorm: maintain per-route score = alpha * recency + beta * frequency + gamma * route_priority; perform fast approximate top-k via reservoir sampling on eviction.
   - Prototype plan: add opt-in config `eviction_policy=soft_global_lru` behind feature flag. Implement simplified scoring and unit tests. Start with alpha=0.7, beta=0.2, gamma=0.1.
   - Risks: increased memory for tracking freq counts; ensure O(1) common-path.

4) Kernel segfaults in canary (p4d, nightly)
   - Error: intermittent SIGSEGV inside fused_attention_cuda.cu, stacktrace points to index offset calc.
   - Past fixes: alignment checks added last month in PR 642, but stack shows different path (mixed-quant path).
   - Repro: hard to reproduce locally; try to capture minidump from canary and attach to GH issue. Add guard checks and sanitize inputs in attention wrapper; slow path acceptable for now.
   - Next: push tiny guard patch to canary, collect metrics for 24h. If crash gone, iterate and write regression test.

5) To-do (quick wins)
   - Add more granular healthcheck events to infra metrics (reason code) -> helps K80 fallback. (small change, low risk)
   - Add unit test for kernel selector boundaries at 1536/2048.
   - Add perf-run CI job for seq_len=2048 nightly.
   - Draft short note for 1:1 with Will about rollout cadence for kernel updates.

Meeting notes (sync w/ Marco 10:30)
- Talked through K80 issue and healthcheck logging. Agreed to land logging change behind flag and enable for Customer A only.
- Marco will ping infra team about oom_kill alerts; may be noisy but we can correlate with health events.
- Priya to own 2048 perf harness and report p99 numbers tomorrow morning.

Misc scratch bits:
- Quick command to run local microbench: `bin/serving-bench --model llama-13b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --reps 100`
- Note: consider bumping default shard eviction TTL from 30m -> 45m for workloads with many short-lived routes; need to measure mem impact.
- Partial thought: for KV-cache, could try probabilistic caching (sample 1/N requests) to limit tracking overhead. Worth a spike.

Open questions:
- If healthchecker marks node unhealthy due to ephemeral oom, should we have a backoff that is exponential but capped at 5 minutes? Current backoff seems linear and long.
- How to get deterministic reproducer for segfaults on mixed-quant path? Need to capture exact binary and input sequence; maybe instrument canary to log seed+inputs on failure before crash.

End-of-day plan:
- land healthcheck logging patch behind flag (small PR)
- kick off 2048 perf harness and leave overnight
- start spike for soft_global_lru eviction implementation

Random note to self: remember to update the rollout playbook with the new canary-metrics we added last month so on-call knows which metrics to look at.
